text.text_excerpt: We really enjoyed Mother Mary's. It is a kitchen situated inside of the Holy Ground Irish Pub, a bar with friendly staff, good pool tables, and well kept dart boards. On a Monday night, they had an array of sports on the television, which was nice because they had music in the background. The bartender was really nice, engaging, and gorgeous. The food here was spectacular for bar food, which is why I reviewed this place in the restaurant category. They have an appetizer that is a hard boiled egg, wrapped in sausage, and deep fried served with an aeoli. Mother Mary's, bless their heart, saved ma' life on Saint Patrick's Day. They are located inside The Holy Ground. I gave up drinking for Lent, but gave myself mulligans for Saint Patrick's Day which was also the eve of my fiance's birthday. And literally with the amount I did drink, compared to the crowds at some of the other bars, I still appeared incredibly sober. That being said, the hangry was creepin' up on me like a leprechaun creeps up on a pot of gold at the end of a rainbow, slowly and sneak-ily. Yeah I said, it...sneak-ily. I headed to the little window in the back post-haste to put in an order for tw0 fried chicken sliders ($3 each), chargrilled beef slider ($3 + .50 dressed +....

I'm not sure where the other reviewers are from but I live in Mid-City and come here often. And I've come to tell you the burger sliders here are better than anything you've met in your life. Even your husband/ wife. Not just the burgers but the spicy egg rolls. Joking aside the food is decent. It's certainly not terrible. And the guy that works the window, - it's just him, he always remembers your names and whatever changes you want to make to your food. He's quiet but otherwise a nice guy. Yes it can take a bit for the food (though 10-20 mins max) but it's just him. I highly recommend the sliders. This is a totally chill neighborhood joint and Mother Mary's is the icing on the cake!
